dropSub: Click to browse, drag a file here, or paste an image
dropHint: PNG · JPG · WEBP · HEIC, up to 40MB
guideSteps: Upload a photo you want to use as a drawing reference.
Adjust it with filters and sliders: opacity, sharpness, edge strength and more.
Tap “Open Camera” to switch to your live camera feed.
The edited image appears as an overlay on top of the camera.
Place your paper underneath, in view of the camera.
Drag, pinch, or rotate the overlay until it lines up with your paper.
Fine-tune opacity, then tap “Start Drawing Mode” and trace by hand.
errUnsupported: Unsupported file type. Please use PNG, JPG, WEBP, or HEIC.
errTooLarge: File is too large. Maximum size is 40MB.
errCantRead: Couldn't read this image. If it's HEIC, try converting it to JPG first.
errCamera: Camera access denied or unavailable. Check your browser/site permissions.
guidePrivacy: Privacy: everything happens on your device. Your photo and camera feed are never uploaded to any server.
metaDescription: Turn any photo into a sketch reference and trace it over your live camera. Free, open source, and private: everything runs in your browser.
heroText: Turn any photo into a clean sketch reference and see it over your live camera. Line it up with your paper, then trace with confidence.
illustrationLabel: A sketch reference lined up over paper in the camera view
howTitle: From photo to paper in four steps
step1Text: Choose a photo from your device. JPG, PNG and WEBP work everywhere. HEIC opens in Safari.
step2Text: Pick a sketch filter and fine-tune opacity, brightness, contrast, sharpness and edges.
step3Text: Open the camera, place your paper underneath, then drag, pinch and rotate the overlay to fit.
step4Text: Switch to Drawing Mode for a clean view, set the opacity and start drawing.
featuresTitle: Everything you need to trace. Nothing you don't.
feat1Text: Grayscale, high contrast, sketch, edge detect and blueprint looks, computed on your device.
feat2Text: Opacity, brightness, contrast, sharpness, edge strength, saturation and blur.
feat3Text: Your reference floats over the rear camera so you can see it right on the paper.
feat4Text: Move with one finger, pinch and twist with two, flip or lock the position when it fits.
feat5Text: Hides every control except opacity, so nothing gets in the way while you draw.
feat6Text: Touch gestures on mobile and keyboard shortcuts on desktop. No install required.
valueFreeText: No subscription, no account, no watermark.
valueOpenText: MIT licensed. Read, fork and improve the code on GitHub.
valuePrivateText: Images and camera frames never leave your device.
ctaText: Pick a photo and have a reference on your paper in under a minute.
faq1a: A free browser tool that turns a photo into a sketch-style reference and shows it over your live camera, so you can line it up with your paper and trace it by hand.
faq2a: No. Your image is decoded and processed in your browser. It is never sent to a server, and it's discarded when you close or reload the page.
faq3a: No. The camera is only used as a live preview behind your reference. Nothing is recorded, saved or sent anywhere, and the camera turns off when you leave the camera screen.
faq4a: JPG, PNG and WEBP work in all modern browsers, up to 40 MB. HEIC and HEIF open in browsers that can decode them, such as Safari on iPhone, iPad and Mac. In other browsers, convert the file to JPG first.
faq5a: Yes. It's designed for phones and tablets: it uses the rear camera, and you can pinch to scale and twist to rotate the overlay. A phone stand above the paper helps a lot.
faq6a: Yes. It's free and open source under the MIT License. No account or subscription is needed.
faq7a: The browser needs camera permission and a secure (HTTPS) connection. If you denied access earlier, allow the camera for this site in your browser or system settings and try again.
privacyIntro: Giotto Sketch Studio is designed so your photos and your camera stay yours. This policy explains, in plain language, what the app does with your data and everything it doesn't do.
termsIntro: These terms govern your use of the Giotto Sketch Studio web app and site. Please read them carefully.
setAppearanceHint: System follows your device's light or dark setting.
aboutText: A drawing reference helper that runs entirely in your browser.
resetConfirm: Reset language and appearance to their defaults?
privacyL1: Your images never leave your device.
privacyL2: All image processing happens in your browser.
privacyL3: The camera is a live preview only. Nothing is recorded.
privacyL4: No account, no cookies, no analytics, no ads.
privacyL5: Only your language and appearance choices are saved, on this device.
privacy2p: When you choose, drop or paste an image, it is decoded and processed locally by your browser. It is never uploaded to a server, never shared with us or anyone else, and never stored permanently. The image is cleared from memory when you close or reload the page.
privacy3p: Camera access is requested only when you tap Open Camera, and only after your browser asks for your permission. The camera image is shown on your screen behind your reference and is not recorded, saved or transmitted. The camera turns off as soon as you leave the camera screen. You can revoke the permission at any time in your browser or device settings.
privacy4p: The app keeps two small preferences in your browser's local storage:
privacy4b: Your appearance preference: System, Light or Dark
privacy4c: These values never leave your device. You can delete them with Settings → Reset Settings or by clearing your browser's site data.
privacy5p: Giotto Sketch Studio uses no cookies, no analytics or tracking tools, no advertising and no third-party scripts. We do not build profiles and we do not sell or share personal data.
privacy6p: The site is a set of static files served by GitHub Pages. Like any web host, GitHub may process technical information such as your IP address and browser type in order to deliver the files and keep the service secure. This is governed by GitHub's own privacy statement.
privacy8h: Changes to the app and this policy
privacy8p: We may update this policy as the app evolves. The date at the top always shows the latest version. We also reserve the right to change, suspend, discontinue, remove or delete the app, the site or any feature at any time, with or without notice.
privacy9p: Because we never receive your images or personal data, there is nothing for us to access, correct or delete on your behalf. You stay in control: close the page to clear images, and reset or clear site data to remove preferences.
privacy10p: Questions about privacy? Reach us [[on GitHub]]. The full source code is public, so every statement on this page can be verified.
terms1p: By opening the site or using the app you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use them.
terms2p: Giotto Sketch Studio is a free drawing reference helper. It turns a photo into a sketch-style reference and shows it over your live camera so you can trace and practise by hand. It is not a measuring, surveying, printing or professional tool. No account is required and all processing happens on your device.
terms3p: Your images are processed in your browser and are never uploaded or stored by us. The camera is a live preview and is not recorded. Only your language and appearance preferences are saved, locally on your device. See the [[Privacy Policy]] for details.
terms4p: You keep all rights to the images you use and the drawings you create. Because your images never reach us, you grant us no license to them. You are responsible for having the rights needed for the images you use.
terms5a: Do not use the app to infringe anyone's copyright, personality or privacy rights.
terms6p: Use your camera responsibly and be mindful of your surroundings. Make sure any phone stand or tripod is stable. Results depend on your device, browser, camera and lighting.
terms7p: The app's source code is published under the MIT License and is public [[on GitHub]]. The license file in the repository governs use of the code. The name and logo of Giotto Sketch Studio are not licensed for use as your own brand.
terms8p: We reserve the right to change, improve, suspend, discontinue, remove or permanently delete the app, the site or any part of them at any time, with or without notice, and without liability to you. We are under no obligation to keep the service available.
terms9p: The app is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including that it will be uninterrupted, error-free or fit for a particular purpose.
terms10p: To the extent permitted by applicable law, we are not liable for any direct or indirect damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, the app, including loss of data or work.
terms11p: We may update these terms from time to time. The date at the top shows the latest version. Continuing to use the app after a change means you accept the updated terms.
terms12p: For questions or feedback, reach us [[on GitHub]].
